basis: Actual-module design case source-confirmed by an independent Astra/xhigh scout; no runtime reproduction is claimed.
defect: Target admission records no source identity. A source may retain a full prepared or completed transfer while target publication is missing or later erased, and eraseSubject can enumerate only KV links/sessions, not that authoritative source object.
performance_budget: One bounded source-intent write and serialized target registration/sequence write per new link admission; erasure-only target barrier/page reads, exact source calls, registration acknowledgements and existing R2 checkpoints. Record operation counts; make no serving-latency or capacity claim.
rollback: Reviewed inverse only on the four pinned source/test files; preserve prior remediation and unrelated dirty changes. New durable registration, source-intent and v5 job records require compatibility review before rollback.
limitations: Prospective registrations only; historical unregistered source discovery/migration, external and physical erasure, session-host parity, cutover/deployment, customer data, native/browser/customer/SLO/release acceptance and full W35/F06/F14 remain open.
